notes.title: Game is not going offline, actually
notes.content:
Hey, gonna be leaving the playtest up for another week.
Here's a bunch of quality of live improvements, the 2 main things being the Undo button, and making your hand more legible when you have a lot of stuff in it.

notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
Heyo,
lots more bugfixes and UI clarity!
Playtest will probably wrap early next week! Have fun!
